name: Candle shadow percent
summary: This EA trades based on candlestick shadow percentage patterns, identifying candles with disproportionately long upper or lower shadows relative to their body size. It generates buy signals when lower shadows dominate and sell signals when upper shadows dominate, interpreting these as potential rejection patterns and reversal signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于K线影线百分比形态进行交易，通过识别相对于实体比例过长的上影线或下影线来判断市场拒绝信号。当底部影线占主导时产生买入信号，当顶部影线占主导时产生卖出信号，将这些视为潜在的反转形态。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于K线影线与实体的百分比关系来判断价格拒绝区域和潜在反转点。入场条件为：当下影线占蜡烛总高度的百分比超过设定阈值时做多，当上影线占比超过阈值时做空，这代表价格在影线方向被拒绝。出场条件通常依赖固定的止盈止损比例或影线百分比回归正常水平时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数或基于资金百分比的仓位计算方式，缺乏动态调整机制。资金管理方面较为简单，没有根据影线百分比强度来调整仓位大小的逻辑，风险控制主要依赖止损设置。整体策略逻辑直观易懂，影线百分比确实能反映多空力量的博弈结果，但单一指标判断容易受到市场噪音干扰。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is based on the percentage relationship between candlestick shadows and the body to identify price rejection zones and potential reversal points. Entry conditions are: go long when the lower shadow percentage of the total candle height exceeds a set threshold, and go short when the upper shadow percentage exceeds the threshold, representing price rejection in the shadow direction. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss ratios or closing when shadow percentages revert to normal levels. Position sizing uses fixed lots or account percentage-based calculation without dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management is relatively simple, lacking logic to adjust position size based on shadow percentage strength, and risk control mainly depends on stop-loss settings. The overall strategy logic is intuitive and easy to understand, as shadow percentages do reflect the outcome of bullish-bearish power struggles, but single-indicator judgment is susceptible to market noise interference.

parameters.name: ShadowPercentThreshold
parameters.description: 影线占比阈值，超过此值触发信号
parameters.description_en: Wick ratio threshold to trigger signal

parameters.name: MinCandleSize
parameters.description: 最小蜡烛尺寸过滤，避免小蜡烛噪音
parameters.description_en: Minimum candle size filter to avoid noise

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to close (0 for all positions)

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，影线百分比确实能反映市场多空博弈的真实情况
影线拒绝形态是经典的蜡烛图分析概念，具有可靠的技术分析基础
参数较少，便于优化和回测，不容易产生过度拟合的问题
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive; shadow percentages genuinely reflect real market bullish-bearish dynamics
Shadow rejection patterns are a classic candlestick analysis concept with a reliable technical analysis foundation
Few parameters make it easy to optimize and backtest without excessive overfitting risk
cons: 单一K线形态判断容易受到市场噪音和假信号的干扰，缺乏多时间框架确认
没有考虑市场趋势方向，在强趋势中逆势影线信号可能导致连续亏损
缺少资金管理和仓位动态调整机制，固定手数交易在不同账户规模下适应性差
cons_en: Single candlestick pattern judgment is susceptible to market noise and false signals, lacking multi-timeframe confirmation
Does not consider market trend direction; counter-trend shadow signals in strong trends can lead to consecutive losses
Lacks money management and dynamic position sizing; fixed lot trading adapts poorly across different account sizes
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势过滤，仅在主趋势方向上交易影线信号，避免逆势交易
加入影线百分比强度递进的仓位管理逻辑，信号越强仓位越大，提高盈亏比
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filtering to only trade shadow signals in the direction of the main trend, avoiding counter-trend trades
Implement progressive position sizing based on shadow percentage strength—stronger signals warrant larger positions to improve risk-reward ratio

risk_points: 单一K线形态信号缺乏趋势过滤，在单边行情中可能频繁逆势入场导致连续止损
缺少最大回撤控制和单日最大亏损限制，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Single candlestick pattern signals lack trend filtering; frequent counter-trend entries in trending markets can cause consecutive stop-losses
No maximum drawdown control or daily loss limit; risk exposure is uncontrolled during extreme market conditions
